svg.text: EULOGIO "AMANG" RODRIGUEZ INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
EARIST E-GATEPASS VISITOR ACCESS MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
Conceptual Framework (IPO Model: Input - Process - Output) | Proponents: Mary Joy Cagande, Joseph Habana, Mon Gerald Lanon, Jeferson Tambis | Adviser: Dhani San Jose

g.text: INPUT: SYSTEM INPUTS & INDEPENDENT VARIABLES
Raw Demographic Data, Verification Assets & Hardware Signals
1. Visitor Demographics & Identity Information
• Full Legal Name (First Name, Middle Name, Last Name)
• Contact Number (E.164 Standard) & Valid Email Address
• Biological Sex (Required Selection: Male / Female)
• Residential Locality: Hierarchical PSGC Address Selection
• Detailed Purpose of Visit (Academic, Official, Transaction, Event)
• Target Campus Office, Department & Faculty Host Selection
• Scheduled Date & Permitted Time Window Selection
• Consent Acceptance for Data Processing (RA 10173 Compliance)
2. Physical Identification Evidence & Biometrics
• High-Resolution Front Snapshot of Government / School ID Card
• Optional Back Snapshot of Identification Document
• Live Camera Facial Portrait Capture via Front Webcam
• Camera Viewport Calibration (Unmirrored Stream Alignment)
• Transient Biometric Vector for Returning Visitor Verification
• Visitor Consent Agreement for Data Processing (RA 10173 Compliance)
• Immediate In-Memory Staging with Zero-Persistence on Cancellation
• Real-time Image Quality & Lighting Assessment
3. Optional Vehicle Declaration Details
• Vehicle Classification (Car, Motorcycle, Van, Utility Vehicle)
• Official License Plate Number (Formatted & Normalized Key)
• Vehicle Exterior Color & Distinctive Visual Identifiers
• Make & Model Classification via NHTSA vPIC Catalog
• Driver vs Passenger Declaration for Multi-Visitor Groups
• Historical Vehicle Recall for Returning Visitors
4. Security Edge & Hardware Peripheral Signals
• Cloudflare Turnstile Cryptographic Client Challenge Token
• Client Device Identifier & Browser User-Agent Fingerprint
• High-Speed Optical Video Stream from Gate Scanner Cameras
• Security Guard Active Session Credentials & Station Device ID
• Campus Emergency Lockdown Status from Administrative Channel
• Hardware Health Status of Kiosk Thermal Printer
5. Institutional Policy & Reference Datasets
• Philippine Standard Geographic Code (PSGC) Nationwide Hierarchy
• Institutional Campus Calendar Closures & Declared Holidays
• Campus Operating Hours & Department-Specific Schedule Rules
• Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Permissions & TOTP MFA Seeds
• Maximum Campus Occupancy Threshold Limits
PROCESS: THROUGHPUT & TRANSFORMATION MECHANISMS
Algorithmic Validation, Cryptography, Database Transactions & State Control
1. Client-Side Parsing & Edge Threat Mitigation
• React Form State Machine: Strict Schema Validation & Sanitization
• Hierarchical Geographic Resolution against 40,000+ PSGC Records
• Client-Side Tesseract.js WebAssembly OCR Text Extraction
• Fuzzy Name String Matching (Comparing ID Card Text to Form Input)
• Webcam Feed Liveness Assessment & Face Alignment Filtering
• Cloudflare Turnstile Siteverify Challenge Validation via Edge API
• Transient Blob URL Management & Memory Cleanup on User Cancel
• Discreet Camera Overlay System Operation
2. Pass Generation & Cryptographic Integrity
• Execution of Atomic Stored Procedure: api.issue_pass
• Public Reference UUID Generation (Unique Identifier)
• Cryptographic SHA-256 HMAC Token Hashing & Salt Ingestion
• Encrypted Pass Digest Generation (32-Byte Strict Octet Length)
• Dynamic 2D QR Matrix Construction (Error Correction Level M)
• Asynchronous Transactional Email Dispatch via Resend REST API
• Thermal Receipt Rendering via Canvas for Kiosk Hardware
• Fail-Closed Concurrency Fencing & Write Freeze Verification
3. Campus Office Routing & Visit Adjudication
• Conditional Visit Routing: General Entry vs Restricted Office Review
• Real-Time WebSocket Notification to Target Department (/office)
• Faculty Host Inspection Queue: Approve / Reject / Reschedule
• Automatic Pass State Gating: pending_approval -> approved
• Automated Visitor Notification Email on Office Decision
• Departmental Working Hours Verification
4. Physical Turnstile Scanning & State Transition
• High-Speed QR Video Frame Ingestion via ZXing (<500ms Latency)
• Token Lookup against Database via PgBouncer Connection Pooler
• Temporal Validity Verification (Current Date & Expiration Window)
• Institutional Calendar Closure & Active Gate Rules Check
• Strict Finite State Machine: issued -> checked_in -> checked_out
• Concurrent Gate Scan Lease Fencing (Advisory Lock Mechanism)
5. Security Oversight, Auditing & Ledger Commit
• Row Level Security (RLS) Enforcement on Database Access
• Append-Only Recording of Entry/Exit Events into visit_events
• System Administrative Trail Recording into immutable audit_events
• Real-Time In-Campus Occupancy Counter Calculation
• Security Alert Flagging for Expired, Duplicate, or Overstay Passes
• Emergency Gate Access Freeze Propagation via Realtime Broker
OUTPUT: SYSTEM DELIVERABLES & DEPENDENT VARIABLES
Secure Access Passes, Physical Gate Grants, Real-Time Logs & Compliance Audits
1. Digital Gate Pass & Visitor Deliverables
• Cryptographically Signed Digital Gate Pass (Responsive Mobile View)
• High-Density Tamper-Resistant Dynamic QR Code Matrix
• Printed Thermal Gate Pass Receipt (Kiosk Self-Service Slips)
• Transactional Confirmation Email with Direct Pass Access Link
• Unique Public Reference Tracking Code for Status Inquiries (/track)
• Clear Visual Ingress Instructions & Campus Security Guidelines
• Real-Time Visit State Display (Approved, Pending, Checked-In)
2. Physical Gate Access Control & Operational Grants
• Immediate Electronic Turnstile Gate Unlock Signal (Green Light)
• Sub-Second Optical Scan Feedback for High-Volume Gate Ingress
• Audible & Visual Denial Feedback for Invalid / Expired Passes
• Immediate Gate Lockdown Freeze during Campus Emergencies
• Physical Security Guard Inspection Dossier on Guard Terminal
• Side-by-Side Photo & Identity Verification for Access Adjudication
• Physical Gate Entry Logging with Hardware Device Attribution
3. Guard Station & Campus Security Telemetry
• Live In-Campus Visitor Occupancy Headcount Display
• Real-Time Dynamic Activity Stream of Ingress / Egress Events
• Searchable Visitor Verification Dossier with ID & Photo
• Flagged Incident Logs & Manual Guard Intervention Records
• Gate Scanner Device Health & Online/Offline Pairing Status
• Instant Overstay Flagging & Detention Audio-Visual Alert
4. Administrative Governance & Compliance Assets
• Immutable Security Audit Trail (audit_events & visit_events)
• Staff Login History, MFA Challenge Logs & Session Traces
• Institutional Visitor Volume Analytics (Daily / Monthly Peaks)
• Department-Wise Visitation Reports for Campus Resource Planning
• Compliance Proof for Philippine Data Privacy Act (RA 10173)
• Complete Historical Event Logs for Post-Incident Forensics
5. Fast Re-Identification & Return Profiles
• Returning Visitor Profile Record (Consent-Gated & Time-Limited)
• Registered Vehicle Catalog for Rapid Future Clearance
• 30-Second Express Check-In for Frequent Campus Visitors
• Automated Anonymization & Data Pruning on Expired Records
• Transient Facial Vector Storage with Expiry Lifecycle

svg.text: FEEDBACK & GOVERNANCE LOOP: Returning Profiles • Overstay Alerts • Capacity Limits
